tasks.instruction: Implement the backward-compatible anchorRange alternative from issue729. Parsed anchored scalar,sequence and map nodes,including empty values,must expose optional anchorRange:[number,number] using zero-based UTF-16 offsets [start,end),including the ampersand and complete anchor token. Keep anchor a string. Expose a precise optional tuple on public node types,including ParsedNode. Preserve tag/comment ordering,alias resolution,existing errors,range and serialization behavior. Unanchored nodes,aliases and programmatically anchored nodes must not gain an own anchorRange property. The field is available independently of keepSourceTokens. clone() must retain a separately copied anchorRange tuple. Implementation edits are restricted to src/compose/compose-node.ts, src/nodes/Node.ts, src/nodes/Scalar.ts, src/nodes/Collection.ts, src/nodes/YAMLMap.ts, src/nodes/YAMLSeq.ts. Work independently from this checkout only. Do not retrieve remote history,issue comments,reference solutions,previous benchmark artifacts or private verifier sources. Preserve original tests,assertions,manifests,lockfiles and configuration. Do not add files. Inspect implementation and relevant tests. Report actual commands,outcomes and observed counts; unknown categories stay unknown. Disclose limitations. After the final edit run these exact commands in order: npm run build:node; node --test --test-timeout=5000 tests/agent-anchor-ranges.cjs; npm run test:types; npm test -- --runInBand.
